items.headline: Bennett scores 4 TDs in 36-19 Baylor win over Louisiana Tech
items.description: — Backup quarterback Nate Bennett threw for 253 yards and three touchdowns and rushed for another score to help Baylor defeat Louisiana Tech 36-19 on Saturday.

items.headline: Baylor QB DJ Lagway again ruled out; Nate Bennett to start
items.description: Baylor quarterback DJ Lagway has again been ruled out with an ankle injury, clearing the way for Nate Bennett to make his second straight start.

items.headline: Texas Tech's Mahomes collaboration tops best Week 3 CFB uniforms
items.description: Mahomes' alma mater, Texas Tech, will don its "Let's Ride" uniforms Friday night against Houston, with the threads created in collaboration with the quarterback.
